comment: The release allowlist. Only what is listed here can reach the release folder and the ZIP; a missing source fails the build, and any file in the output that no rule produced fails the build too.
name: TankTrouble-Skin-Tools

runtime.why: Runs before the game starts: frame sizes, image maths, and the hook that recolours and re-textures tank sprites as the game creates them.
The panel: skin import and validation, local storage of installed skins and choices, previews, and the on-screen controls.

16.why: Toolbar and extensions page icon (16 px).

128.why: Install dialog and store icon (128 px).

files.why: The licence travels with the code.

skinPacks.why: Example skins a player can install with Manage skins > Add a folder. Each file is a frame the extension draws, or the pack's skin.json.

documents.why: The illustrated installation guide players open first (one file, screenshots embedded).
What the extension stores, and that nothing leaves the browser.
Credits and licences for third-party work behind the example skins.
